title: Fractured Mirror Reflection
description: A woman in red lingerie and a yellow bandana stands in a surreal bedroom, looking over her shoulder at a large cracked oval mirror. Her reflection shows her taking a selfie while her arm transforms into a demonic, fiery, clawed appendage reaching through the broken glass toward a swirling red vortex.
prompt: A young woman wearing a red bra and panties with a yellow bandana and long braided hair stands in a decaying psychedelic bedroom with floral wallpaper and scattered photos. She looks back at a large cracked oval mirror where her reflection is taking a selfie, but her arm has become a monstrous demonic clawed limb with glowing orange cracks reaching through the shattered mirror into a swirling red and black vortex, surreal horror atmosphere, detailed painting
